incident-bot: SEV-2: hosted-runtime kvcache nodes experiencing repeated OOMs in eu-west-1. Pager -> @sam. Runbook: https://ops.redwood/incident/2371112222 :rotating_light:
sam (SRE): got the page. seeing pod restarts on runtime-kvcache-eu-*. GPU mem pressure rising on ~5 pods. latency spikes for text-gen tail.
lina (runtime): pulling logs. pattern: a subset of sessions are growing KV length each step despite identical user turns. Looks like prefix replay + prefetch wins that never gets evicted because batch controller extends window when coalescing similar sessions.
jorge (eng): could this be caused by the new tool-call buffer that appends tool outputs into prompt history? we shipped that change yesterday to reduce token truncation.
lina (runtime): possible. I'm seeing repeated tool output echoes in the streamed responses: tool output -> user echo -> tool -> ... appears to create a loop for some agents that auto-append. prefetch pulls full history, continuous batching holds onto KV until eviction trigger. if each iteration grows by 200-400 tokens, we'll hit GPU mem fast.
sam (SRE): customer impact: ~2 enterprise tenants affected, error rate up ~6% across requests to hosted text-gen endpoints for the region. self-serve customers mostly unaffected.
emily (support): notifying tenant contacts now: brief status note, ETA for mitigation?
sam (SRE): ETA 20-40m for canary hotfix. mitigation plan: 1) disable prefetch on hosted kvcache pool 2) lower continuous-batch max_window_tokens from 1200 -> 300 3) add conservative eviction ramp (kv_eviction_threshold from 0.8 -> 0.65) 4) forcibly kill top noisy sessions.
jorge (eng): I can revert the tool-call append change but prefer runtime guard first for immediate safety. will prepare a revert-only PR if needed.
lina (runtime): hotfix config prepared:
```
# emergency kvcache/batch controller tweak
continuous_batch:
  max_window_tokens: 300
  prefetch_enabled: false
  kv_eviction_threshold: 0.65
  per_session_kv_hard_limit: 4096
```
applying to canary now.
ops-bot: deploy started: runtime/kvcache-hotfix canary -> pod/runtime-kvcache-canary-7
sam (SRE): watching metrics: memory usage on canary flattened within 60s, request errors on canary down ~80%.
lina (runtime): rolling to remaining pods with 20s stagger; keeping one pod for telemetry-only to observe any hidden regressions.
incident-bot: note: autoscaler initiated replacement nodes due to OOM churn 12. Temporary increased infra churn may show in metrics.
emily (support): update posted to tenants: "We're actively mitigating an issue causing failures on very long/looped prompt sessions in eu-west-1. Hotfix rolling; will update again in 30m."
sam (SRE): found one persistent session s-cc7d that kept rehydrating KV from external prefetch cache. Lina, can you force-evict and terminate session?
lina (runtime): forcing eviction + terminating s-cc7d. mem reclaimed. marking session id in blacklist to avoid immediate respawn while we patch.
jorge (eng): creating a followup task: add a server-side guard that rejects prefetch requests when session_kv > 2500 tokens and returns a 413-like client_rejected_long_context error. also add telemetry to trace sequences that grow > 200 tokens/step.
sam (SRE): rolling metrics: cluster error rate dropping to ~1.2% region-wide. keeping alerts on.
emily (support): tenants acknowledged update; one tenant asked about potential data loss.
sam (SRE): no user data lost; only live sessions were terminated. include that in customer note.
ops-bot: rollout status: 9/12 pods updated. memory growth rate cluster P99 down 95%.
jorge (eng): will open PR for runtime guard + revert plan for tool-append change. PR expected in 45m.
sam (SRE): incident timeline: root cause hypothesis: tool-call append change enabled deterministic loop patterns in some customer agents; continuous-batching + aggressive prefetch caused unbounded KV growth for a small set of sessions -> GPU OOMs on hosted kvcache pods.
sam (SRE): next actions: 1) postmortem + RCA 2) runtime guard (hard per-session KV cap + prefetch rejection) 3) test harness for repeated tool-call loops 4) evaluate autoscaler replacement aggressiveness under OOM churn 5) update runbook to include prefetch kill switch.
incident-bot: incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to SEV-3 at 2371112445.
sam (SRE): handing off to night oncall (@sam-night). leaving notes in incident doc and linking followup tickets. please watch metric: kvcache.per_session_kv_len_99 and runtime.gpu_mem_growth_rate.
emily (support): drafting customer RCA summary. will sync with sam before sending.
sam (SRE): thanks all. closing thread here; will attach postmortem once complete. :white_check_mark:
